facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; contracts over USD 50,000 need registration and repatriation.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: hold foreign bank accounts without notifying the National Bank.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local providers like Kaspi Pay weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: File a free notice as an individual entrepreneur online via eGov with an EDS.
facts.L2_tax_id: An identification number in the national register; how freelancers apply isn't confirmed.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: From 2026: 10% income tax, 15% above about KZT 33.4m.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 16% VAT from 2026, above about KZT 43 million turnover.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law on Personal Data No. 94-V; data localisation is widely reported.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: Simplified declaration: 4% tax (2% in some areas), but not for all activities.
facts.D1_id_document: ID card or passport, plus an electronic digital signature (EDS).

watch_out.text: Foreign contracts above USD 50,000 must be registered with your bank.
